description: A React component for the right sidebar in Mattermost, managing display of channel info, members, search, and related UI interactions.

classes.name: SidebarRight
classes.description: React component managing the right sidebar UI, including focus handling, keyboard shortcuts, and content rendering based on props.

methods.name: setPrevious
methods.description: Stores current sidebar state as previous for restoring focus or state.

methods.name: handleShortcut
methods.description: Handles keyboard shortcuts for toggling sidebar, showing info, etc.

methods.name: handleRHSFocus
methods.description: Manages focus when sidebar opens or closes.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Adds event listeners for keyboard and mouse events.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Updates focus and sidebar state based on prop changes.

methods.name: handleClickOutside
methods.description: Closes sidebar if click occurs outside.

methods.name: handleUpdateSearchTerms
methods.description: Updates search terms and focuses search bar.

methods.name: getSearchBarFocus
methods.description: Sets callback to focus search bar.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the sidebar UI with conditional content.
